title: HelpDeskCatalogSchema
description: Standard schema for AI-generated Japanese documentation for Linux packages and CLI commands.

command.description: The exact name of the executable command or package (e.g. 'tar', 'w3m', 'req')

category.description: Category in Japanese. Standard categories: 'ファイル操作・圧縮', 'ネットワーク・通信', '自作開発ツール', 'システム監視・プロセス', '開発・エディタ', 'モダンCLI拡張'

summary_ja.description: Concise one-line summary in Japanese explaining the tool's core purpose

description_ja.description: Comprehensive explanation in Japanese detailing what problem the tool solves and when to use it

options.description: List of the most commonly used flags and parameters

desc_ja.description: Clear explanation of this flag in Japanese

description_ja.description: What this specific example achieves in Japanese
